comments.value: That's already a feature of the website, but having that in-game wouldn't be so bad.

comments.mergedPostDetails: the ability to see how long people have been offline on your friends list so like " last online 4 hours ago"

comments.value: Currently, VRChat shows when a friend last logged in. This causes a problem when a friend doesn't have to reauthenticate for a couple days and shows up with an old last login timestamp while in fact the user has been online more recently than that. What we want instead is a last activity timestamp, the timestamp of the last instance ping to be precise.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
It's not normal that a friend who disconnected 5 minutes ago is marked as "Active 4 months ago"
And It's not normal that when I look at who is connected from the website, the friends go from connected to disconnected even though they are well connected
Correct that please.
